Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Junior Data Engineer with ETL development and geospatial data experience to support the data engineering workstream on a federal data migration program. You will develop and deploy ETL pipelines, execute data ingestion workflows, and support spatial data validation activities within a cloud data Lakehouse environment. This is a fully remote position.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

 

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.

 

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

 

Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.

 

Problems you'll work on

- Interactive inference in the annotation editor. Serving heavy vision and multimodal models fast enough that annotators get model suggestions in real time, with their corrections flowing back as feedback.

- Inference at very large scale. Pre-computing model outputs across millions of hours of egocentric video for robotics customers, where throughput, GPU cost and reliability all matter.

- Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.

- One integration, many workflows. Building model integrations that hold up across customers' custom, fast-changing ontologies and task templates, instead of one-off implementations.

What you'll do

- Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models

- Own the serving architecture behind our ML features, justifying trade-offs in latency, throughput, reliability and GPU cost

- Optimise models and pipelines for production through batching, KV caching, GPU utilisation and orchestration

- Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering

- Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates

- Set up monitoring and observability, and own performance and reliability once features are live

- Take prototypes from your research-focused teammates and turn them into shipped features

- Contribute to platform design decisions, take part in design reviews and help us hire

- Work with Python, PyTorch, CUDA, Kubernetes and GCP/AWS

 

Who we're looking for

- An owner. You take ambiguous product needs, make the architecture calls and carry the work all the way into production.

- A systems thinker. You design for scale and reuse, and you know when a simple, solid baseline beats a clever solution.

- A great collaborator. You enjoy working across research, product and engineering, and you make it easier for everyone to ship.

- A bridge between research and production. You speak both languages, help researchers get their work shipped, and feed production lessons back into how models are built.

 

Experience requirements

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time building and operating ML systems or model-backed products in production at scale

- Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals

- Hands-on experience deploying modern deep

title: Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

PARTNER EXCELLENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

- Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

- A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

- Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

- Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial

title: Member of Product Staff, Core Product
description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Core Product is responsible for how doctors and nurses use Abridge every day, and how deeply and broadly they engage with it. That covers the notes clinicians rely on after every visit, how care moves across the inpatient stay and the emergency department, the assistant clinicians ask questions of, nursing workflows, and the voice, mobile, and desktop experiences that clinician’s use.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of these areas end to end. You'll spend real time with clinicians, turn what you learn into product conviction, and ship with engineering, design, machine learning, and clinical science. Success means clinicians who come back to Abridge again and again, and health systems that can see the time saved and value created.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York. Please only apply or consider this opportunity if you are open to Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in office or relocation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own product strategy and execution for your area. Define the vision and roadmap, decide what to build and what not to build, and own the outcomes.

- Earn clinician love. Do deep discovery with physicians, nurses, and advanced practice providers across ambulatory, inpatient, and ED settings. Test hypotheses quickly and iterate on adoption, retention, and perceived time saved.

- Ship AI experiences clinicians trust. Partner with ML and clinical science to define quality bars and evals. Design for uncertainty and edge cases, and know where AI shouldn't be used.

- Make Abridge part of the workflow. Work across EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and Abridge's own surfaces so the experience fits how clinicians already work.

- Grow depth and breadth of engagement. Set clear success metrics, such as active use, retention, workflows per clinician, and time saved, and drive them across care settings and roles.

- Prototype to build conviction. Use AI coding tools to sharpen your own thinking and get the team aligned before engineering commits.

- Operate with a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years of product management experience, including end-to-end ownership of user-facing products you launched, not just optimized.

- Hands-on AI/ML product experience with specifics. You've shipped AI features and have opinions on what makes them good or bad.

- A visible building habit. You prototype, build with AI tools daily, and can show us

title: Audit Analyst - Internal Audit - (Model Risk)
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Being a Model Auditor at Nubank is different from being a traditional auditor. In a digital bank driven by data, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence, our audit function also embraces technology to assess risks predictively and continuously.

This position is fundamental to Nu's success. You will be part of the Internal Audit team, focusing on Financial Risks (Credit, Market, Liquidity, and Capital). Your primary goal will be to provide assurance on Nubank's financial models

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Your main challenge will be to translate statistical and data concepts into auditable financial risks. Your activities will include:

- Evaluating and critiquing risk models (including statistical and Machine Learning models), from their conception, development, and validation to their ongoing monitoring.

- Applying your knowledge of mathematics and statistics to analyze the robustness, performance, and adherence of these models.

- Executing audit tests using data analysis, you will be expected to explore large volumes of data to identify risks, biases, or control failures.

- Leading technical discussions with stakeholders (such as Data Scientists, Engineers, and the Risk team) and communicating audit findings clearly, objectively, and constructively (both verbally and in writing).

title: Commercial Strategy & Growth Lead
description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our Commercial Strategy & Growth Lead, you'll be hands-on, owning pricing, retention and marketplace growth initiatives from idea to result. Which trades should pay what, and where? Why do members churn? How do we ensure our trades get value from our product? You'll find questions like these in our data, answer them yourself and see the answer through to launch. It's a broad remit with real ownership over how we price, how we grow our member base and how we use data, experimentation and AI to run a smarter commercial operation.

The job, unfiltered:

- Spot the opportunity yourself, size it, build the business case and work with cross-functional teams (Product, CRM, Sales, Retention) to deliver it.

- Run experiments to grow revenue: test pricing logic, drive upsell, and increase product attachment, then use the results to shape how our pricing model evolves.

- Tackle churn: look at the health of the member lifecycle, find where value is leaking (including why some members leave early) and lead the work to fix it.

- Work out how supply shapes revenue: understand what happens to leads, conversion and member value when a trade or area runs short of tradespeople, and recommend what we do about it.

- Build the tracking, benchmarking and alerting that keep our pricing sharp, using AI and automation where they genuinely help us move faster.

- Do the doing. You'll work across several programmes at once and move things forward with others, not just write the strategy.

In your first six months, you could ship a pricing test, own a churn intervention programme or build an AI-assisted alerting tool.

The fit:

- You find and own the work: an opportunity you spotted without being asked, sized, built the case for and saw through to a number.

- You’re comfortable with SQL, and turn messy datasets into clear recommendations that drive decisions and action.

- You've made a recommendation that a senior person acted on, and you can explain it in a few clear sentences.

- You think commercially about pricing, retention and member value, and the trade-offs between volume, churn and conversion.

- You might be coming from marketplace supply or category, strategy and operations or BizOps, consulting then industry, subscription propositions, or retail pricing and promotions. You don't need a revenue or pricing job title.

This isn't the role if your work is mainly reporting or dashboards, you want to manage a team, or your experience is pipeline and CRM operations.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Wellhub access, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme & Season Ticket Loan

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- 1st interview with our hiring manager

- 2nd interview: a skills interview with a panel from the team

- Final stage: a short analysis case study presentation

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, just tell your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Manager, Revenue Accounting
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a Manager, Revenue Accounting to join our Finance team in Montreal and lead our software revenue streams. Lightspeed runs on multiple billing engines, and a big part of this role is bringing them together under one umbrella, establishing the standards, governance, and processes that give us a single, consistent view as we build out our revenue accounting flow, documentation, and controls.

Reporting directly to the Director, Global Revenue, you'll lead a team of revenue accountants and own the integrity of our revenue numbers end to end. You'll take the lead on statutory and group audits, build out a robust month-end close with the checks and controls to guarantee the accuracy of our financials, and shape the revenue accounting policies that keep us consistent and compliant as the business grows. If you're a self-motivated leader with deep technical chops, excellent organizational skills, and meticulous attention to detail, this could be the role for you.

What you’ll be doing:

- Leading a team: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of revenue accountants. Setting clear priorities, reviewing their work, and growing their careers as our revenue function scales.

- Owning the full revenue picture: Take ownership of revenue recognition across our software revenue streams, bringing our multiple billing engines together under one umbrella with consistent standards, governance, and processes so we have a single, reliable view across every revenue line.

- Leading month-end close: Build out and own a robust month-end close process, including the controls, checks, and reconciliations needed to guarantee the accuracy of our financials and our revenue. Review journal entries, reconciliations, and revenue schedules across entities.

- Taking the lead on audits: Serve as the primary point of contact for auditors on all revenue matters, taking the lead on statutory and group audits, preparing and reviewing supporting schedules, maintaining audit-ready documentation, and responding to auditor queries.

- Building out policy: Develop and roll out our revenue accounting policies and treatments, documenting positions to an audit-ready standard and keeping us consistent across the organization.

- Overseeing revenue recognition for software and hardware bundles, ensuring compliance with accounting standards while working with cross-functional teams to assess financial impact and optimize reporting accuracy.

- Carrying out (and reviewing) meticulous walkthroughs to understand the transaction flow in each revenue line, and maintaining the complex workbooks that reconcile to our financials.

- Analyzing trends and issues across our revenue lines, and explaining variances clearly to senior management and the Director, Global Revenue.

- Introducing and strengthening controls and quality checks to ensure the accuracy of reporting across diverse systems (ERP, CRMs, billing systems, etc.).

- Leading projects and solving complex problems as the business adapts and shifts its strategic direction in response to varying macros including system enhancements and automation initiatives to scale the function.

- Partnering cross-functionally with FP&A, Sales, Legal, and other stakeholders to proactively identify and resolve revenue accounting issues.

What you need to bring:

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

- 6+ years of combined experience across practice and industry in revenue accounting, technical accounting, and/or audit - including time spent in audit at a financial services firm.

- A must: 2-3 years of proven SaaS revenue accounting experience leading and managing teams.

- Passed the CFE (Common Final Exam) and obtained the CPA title.

- In-depth conceptual and practical knowledge of IFRS 15 and revenue recognition standards, ideally acros

Team/ Role Paragraph:
Blockchain Insights is Coinbase's internal onchain intelligence platform. It combines address attribution from internal teams and external vendors with multi-chain transaction data, and powers KYT, risk scoring, and sanctions screening. Compliance, investigations, and risk teams rely on Blockchain Insights to trace funds and keep Coinbase safe and compliant, and a growing share of that use comes through AI agents via our MCP server. • Daily use of AI coding tools, with good judgment about where they speed you up and where they need close review.

• Ability to break ambiguous problems into well-scoped tasks with clear context and acceptance criteria, for yourself, your teammates, or an agent.

• Passion for building an open financial system that brings the world together.

title: Mainframe Developer (ID)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Mainframe Developer to join our core engineering team and drive the stability, performance, and ongoing evolution of our mission-critical enterprise applications. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high-volume mainframe systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate legacy platforms with modern cloud and API architectures.
What You’ll Do

• Design, develop, test, and maintain complex mainframe applications using COBOL, JCL, DB2, and CICS.

• Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs and efficient batch/online workflows.

• Troubleshoot and resolve critical production incidents, batch abends, and performance bottlenecks within strict SLA timelines.

• Perform SQL query optimization and DB2 database tuning to ensure high-throughput transaction processing.

• Collaborate with distributed and cloud engineering teams to expose legacy business logic via modern APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g., IBM MQ, z/OS Connect).

• Conduct code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and mentor junior and mid-level mainframe developers.

What We’re Looking For
Must-Haves

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in mainframe application development and production support on IBM z/OS environments.

• Strong proficiency in COBOL , JCL , DB2 (embedded SQL), and VSAM .

• Proven experience with online transaction processing using CICS .

• Solid understanding of batch scheduling tools (e.g., Control-M, CA-7) and TSO/ISPF utilities.

• Strong analytical and debugging skills with a track record of resolving high-severity production issues.

Technical Depth

• Deep understanding of mainframe file structures, memory management, and high-volume batch performance tuning.

• Hands-on experience with debugging and testing tools such as Expediter, InterTest, File-AID, or Fault Analyzer.

• Ability to trace end-to-end transaction flows across CICS, DB2, and enterprise messaging queues (IBM MQ).

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with mainframe modernization, API integration (z/OS Connect), or modern DevOps pipelines (Git, Jenkins, IDz).

• Familiarity with additional mainframe languages or databases such as PL/I, Assembler (HLASM), Rexx, or IMS.

• Domain experience in banking, financial services, insurance, or enterprise core systems.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager at Harvey, you are the custodian of value for a portfolio of law firms and in-house legal teams across DACH - you own their mutual success plan and their renewal. You connect Harvey's technology and expertise to each customer's goals, moving them along the AI maturity curve so adoption keeps deepening, and you are directly accountable for retaining and growing that relationship. You will run your book as a portfolio, deliver a consistently high-quality customer journey at scale, and partner with Account Executives, Legal Engineers and Product to turn adoption into measurable value and expansion.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Deliver the customer journey: run kickoffs, implementation reviews and QBRs tailored to each customer, anchored on a mutual success plan that ties Harvey to their objectives, priorities and measures of success.

- Drive adoption and value: engage end users, administrators and senior stakeholders - managing partners, general counsel, heads of innovation - to position Harvey as essential to how their legal work gets done, build on proven use cases, and quantify ROI in business terms.

- Orchestrate cross-functionally: bring in Sales, Legal Engineering, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance at the right moment, and represent customer needs back to Product and Engineering.

- Expand: identify and progress expansion opportunities within your accounts, partnering with Account Executives where appropriate.

- Own the renewal end to end: run your book as a portfolio - knowing whether each account is in Defend, Maintain or Grow, with evidence - build renewal plans and timelines, forecast accurately, lead commercial conversations, negotiate terms and close renewals on or ahead of schedule against a gross and net revenue retention target.

WHAT YOU HAVE

Ideal candidates for the Mid-Market CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

- 3-4+ years in customer-owning roles at tech or SaaS platforms, including direct ownership of renewals, retention or a commercial / account-management target.

- A track record of owning and delivering against a revenue, retention or net-revenue-retention number.

- An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily and can show how it has changed your own output.

- Experience running the renewal motion end to end - forecasting, renewal planning and leading commercial negotiations.

- Account management and portfolio planning across a high-volume book of business, including segmentation and revenue-based prioritisation.

- Quantifying and communicating ROI and measurable business value to customers, grounded in concrete use cases.

- Identifying at-risk accounts early and executing structured mitigation plan

- Broad familiarity with corporate and operational legal matters, with sound judgment about priorities and when to involve specialists.

- Practical business judgment that balances legal protection with commercial goals and speed.

- Clear, concise communication and confidence advising leadership and cross-functional teams.

- Ownership, follow-through, and the ability to manage competing priorities and build practical processes.
